required_question: What decision-relevant question is being answered?
What is the unit of analysis and grain?
Which source fields/tables are required and linked validly?
Which assumptions are observed, derived, illustrative or simulated?
What bias, leakage, confounding or selection risks apply?
Why is the analytical method appropriate for this data structure?
What does the result prove and explicitly not prove?
Which reconciliation, benchmark, test or gate validates the result?
Which management action or decision can use the evidence?
How will the result or intervention be monitored over time?
